purpose: Display-only deviations required to make a local simulation transparent. Original economic config remains byte-identical. No UI nodes, transforms or art changed.
scope: Source key override and exact default-English alias match, so original literal bindings and all five existing locales use the same explicit English test copy.
reason: Remove fake official certification, fabricated other-player payout/approval/percentile claims, promises of bank transfers or instant payments, and requests for real account details. Local order review and simulated success are labeled as test states.
